about: Teel-Fen Weir's people as world facts (person, household, person_note tables; tools/newworld/stockdb.py). Placement (bed, work, routine) stays in newworld/places/outpost-m6-m66/people.jsonl under the same ids. The camp has no roof of its own: Heem-Jasa and the two wardens on watch sleep in its open beds as one household. The three Unbound sap-takers whom quest 3 places at the reed hide are the quest's to place: the draft holds no hostile people to cast them on.

people.name: Heem-Jasa
people.trade: minder of the young Hist; sells sap, swamp fungus and eggshells; teaches alchemy

notes.text: She has tended the weir's young Hist since it first broke from the roots of Jal-Veesa's tree, and she sells what it and the creek give. She speaks bluntly to strangers and has not slept well since its scar closed over the grey paste. She turns the wardens' clutch in the sap pool each morning and sells the shells the hatchlings leave.

people.name: Hulzeeth
people.trade: weir-warden of the levy, night watch; leads the wardens on watch

notes.text: He watches the traps by night for the Sedge-Wardens of Jal-Veesa and counts every stranger who passes the reed hide to the west. His son Tsa-tah keeps the traps by day so that his father can sleep.
He sets and lifts the eel traps along the weir, standing on the log boom with his feet wide. He learned the work from his father Hulzeeth.

people.name: Vasha-Ree
people.trade: weir-warden of the levy, day watch; works the eel traps and loads the catch

notes.text: She works the eel traps by day and loads the catch for Urvyn Farm. She clears the drift off the log boom with a pole.

people.name: Paa-shei
people.trade: cook at the pot by the drying rack

notes.text: She cooks the day's eels and gar in the pot by the drying rack for everyone on the platform. She puts the heads aside for the young Hist's pool.
